system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: I want to perform the following action: Perform these two different actions simultaneously: pmksy_track_application_status and pmksy_schedule_inspection.. my application_id is PMKSY-APP-10000002, my preferred_date is dummy_preferred_date_9624.

function.name: pmksy_schedule_inspection
function.description: Schedules inspection for installed irrigation system. Installation must be completed. Transitions inspection to 'scheduled'. Requires session_token. Fails if not installed or scheduling conflict.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

function.name: pmksy_track_application_status
function.description: Returns application_status ('not_applied', 'submitted', 'under_review', 'approved', 'rejected'). Requires session_token. Does NOT modify. Fails if application_id invalid.
